scope.summary: Token-driven typography: number StudioVariables MAY bind to size, leading, tracking, and paragraph spacing, and string StudioVariables MAY bind to text content and font family, so a StudioVariableCollection can drive typography as design tokens (Figma typography variables). The variable system itself is governed by 14.10; 14.7 wires the type-side binding + re-resolution on variable change.
acceptance_criteria: number+string StudioVariable bindings to type attributes; re-resolve on change; 14.10 variable system referenced
expected_tests: live: number StudioVariable bound to size/leading/tracking/paragraph-spacing re-resolves on change; string StudioVariable bound to content/font-family
test: StudioVariableCollection drives typography as tokens (14.10 system referenced, not forked)

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No token-driven type; design-system typography unmet.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
